RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 25

An all-female panel is not evidence of bias; panel composition typically reflects committee availability, service rotation, or subfield alignment. While your publications and completed PhD are strong, lecturer appointments often heavily prioritize pedagogical fit, interview performance, and industry experience tailored to specific departmental needs.

Raising sex discrimination without concrete evidence—such as documented procedural violations or inappropriate interview conduct—carries severe professional risks and will likely harm your reputation in a small academic discipline. Furthermore, a two-week delay for formal HR feedback is standard administrative lag. 

Follow up courteously about constructive feedback on your application and interview, but do not mention the gender composition of the panel.
